title: Efficient Agentic Audio-Visual Question Answering through Toolset Pruning and Modality Consolidation
abstract: arXiv:2610.38960v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fine-grained audio-visual question answering (AVQA) requires models to resolve complex cross-modal correspondences and temporally grounding from sparsely distributed evidence. Omni-modal agents, which autonomously orchestrate perception tools to actively collect evidence, achieve strong performance, but it remains unclear whether active perception from both audio and visual modalities depends on broad specialized toolsets, especially audio or visual modality-specific tools. Such systems may also introduce long execution trajectories and substantial inference cost. We investigate whether comparable performance can be retained with a compact workflow exposing only essential perceptual capabilities. Starting from the specialized-tool OmniAgent, we conduct staged controlled experiments that prune the toolset and progressively consolidate modality-specific tools into omni-modal tools, motivating a two-tool agent comprising only Omni-modal cap

translated_title: 通过工具集剪枝与模态整合实现高效的智能体音视频问答
translated_abstract: 细粒度音视频问答（AVQA）要求模型解析复杂的跨模态对应关系，并从稀疏分布的证据中进行时间定位。全模态智能体通过自主调度感知工具来主动收集证据，取得了优异的性能，但目前尚不清楚对音频与视觉两种模态的主动感知是否依赖于广泛的专业化工具集，尤其是音频或视觉模态专用的工具。此类系统还可能引入冗长的执行轨迹和高昂的推理成本。我们研究了仅暴露必要感知能力的紧凑工作流能否保持相当的性能。从配备专用工具的OmniAgent出发，我们开展了分阶段的受控实验，对工具集进行剪枝，并逐步将模态专用工具整合为全模态工具，由此构建出一个仅包含全模态能力的两工具智能体。
tldr: 本文通过分阶段的工具集剪枝与模态整合实验，将庞大的专用工具智能体压缩为仅含两个全模态工具的紧凑工作流，在保持细粒度音视频问答性能的同时显著降低推理成本与执行开销。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that staged toolset pruning and consolidating modality-specific tools into a compact two-tool omni-modal agent retain strong fine-grained AVQA performance while substantially reducing execution trajectories and inference cost.
